profile.headline: AI @ CMU | Head TA at CMU CS Academy | SWE @ Google

positions.title: Head TA
positions.description:
Spanish Team: Translate curriculum material and Python code to Spanish. Lead professional developments for Spanish speaking teachers, training them how to code in Python. Bridging the gap of accessible CS education in Spanish speaking countries.
Outreach Team: Introduce new teachers to the curriculum and respond to support tickets, mainly concerning debugging techniques and algorithmic thinking strategies.
CS3: Content creation and review for college level CS class.

positions.title: Administrative Assistant, Administration
positions.description:
Administrative Support: Import tickets for costumer’s technological difficulties.
Technology Consultant: Process tickets by resolving the issue.
Orders Trainee: Process costumer’s Direct Inward Dialing (DIDs) and hardware orders.
Digital Design: Create email templates and flyers for marketing.
